tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab du gyur kyang rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin cing / /dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro la brtse yang gdug can 'gro la khro tshul ston/ /spros bral chos dbyings ngang du gyur kyang sna tshogs spros pa kun ston pa/ /lha mchog de la gus pas btud nas dkyil 'khor cho ga 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon la/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar gsol ba 'debs pa na/ de rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ gnas dben par sgrub thabs ltar lha bskyed nas/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'abum du bskyal/ thun mtshams su yi ge so gnyis pa dang / yi ge bdun pa yang stong stong tsam bzlas te sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug pa la gsum ste/ sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi cho ga dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par skyang nul byas la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ phur bu la sogs pa 'og du dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams nas/ slob dpon sa'i dbus su 'dug la/ sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba'i 'jig rten pa'i gtor mas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba dang / mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te/ lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar byas la/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo brkyang ba gshibs te kha sbubs pas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la reg cing / oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes pas sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang / hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes pas sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin can dang / oṃ me dī ni badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal ldan pa la/

las kyi slob mas phyogs bzhi nas mchod par bsams shing dngos su shar phyogs nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob ma med na rang gis brjod cing bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus la langs te/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar bsams la/ g.yas g.yon du bltas pas bgegs bskrad cing gsos par bsam/ rkang pa hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil zhing / rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bskor la ngag tu yi ge so gnyis pa brjod cing / dbang ldan du gnas pas bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje gzugs ni 'bar ba yis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag la 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /zhes dang / shar du rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang / lhor rin chen/ nub du pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bcug pas bka' bgo zhing / thams cad du rol mo'i sgra drag po dang / yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas pas bgegs bskrad par bsam mo/ /de nas phur bu gcig bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las stod rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang / smad phur bu'i rnam par bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo lcags kyu dang / zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying kha nas lcags kyus phug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bcug la/

de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btsugs shing tho bas brdungs par bsams la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya/ kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ra ya adzñā pa ya ti/ sarba big+naṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing brdungs pas bgegs kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug nas sa gzhi la sbrag par bsams la/ dngos su phur bu dbang ldan du gdab pa ni/ sa yongs su bzung ba ste nub dang po'i bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga ni/ sang nangs par sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar sngon du song nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ der mtshams bcing ba'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas/ paṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lus phyed 'thon pa/ phyag g.yas pas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa spyan drangs nas bdag la phyogs par bzhugs pa la/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams kyis/ oṃ pṛ thī wī sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa la ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pas phul/ nang mchod kyis kyang mchod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ a kā ros phul la/ g.yas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi dpung / /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin pa la slar yang mchod nas sa de nyid du thim par bsams te/

sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir lha gnas mi 'chol bar bya ba'i phyir thig chen brgyad tsam btab pa'am/ yang na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi las thig rdzogs par btab la/ de'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams phyag len bzhin du bshams te/ dri bzangs kyi chus dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du gru bzhir byugs la/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas ya ma rā dza zhal gyi grangs dang mnyam par brjod do/ /de dag bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can nas sgrub thabs ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa cig char bskyed nas gsal gdab pa'i tshe/ thog mar rten gsal gdab ste/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang ngam zhes pa nas lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su rdo rje rwa ba zlum pos bskor ba'i nang du re'u mig gi dbus dang / phyag mtshan rnams kyi gnas dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad dang srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal btab nas dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du gtso bo sgrub thabs ltar gsal gdab/ shar gyi re'u mig tu mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub du thod tshal/ nub byang du dur khrod kyi ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yas nas rim pa bzhin du gri gug 'phang mdung / gtun shing / chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu/ lhor dgra satwa/ mda'/ dbyig pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo/ rdo rje zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rnge'u chung / phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang du sdigs mdzub 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang po che'i lpags pa/ tho ba/ mdung / me thab/ de'i phyi rol gyi sgo mtshams brgyad du/ ro langs chen po brgyad ni/ gcer bu skra grol ba/

mdog nag po khro bo'i gdong pa can/ rab du dmar ba'i mig gsum dang ldan zhing / so rno ba'i kha gdangs nas/ ha ha zhes dgod pa/ srin po lta bu gri gug dang thod pa thogs shing / rus pa'i phreng ba dang / sbrul gyis brgyan te/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas gnas pa'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang / ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ khyad par ni gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas sngags gsum gyi sngags mchod kyis mchod/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs rim pa bzhin sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa man chad thams cad la sbyar zhing / sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /de bzhin du/ me tog 'di/ bdug spos 'di/ mar me 'di/ dri chab 'di/ zhal zas 'di/ rol mo 'di/ zhes pas phyi mchod kyis mchod/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan na/ /lha rdzas na bzas bkang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par byas te dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swāhā/ zhes pas gos zung dang / de bzhin 'don pa bsgyur la/ gzugs mchog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang / /oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du sgra snyan dang / shab+da/ dri mchog dang / gan+dhe/ ro mchog dang / ra sa/ reg 'jam dang / spar+ṣe/ zhes pas dbul zhing de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te thod pa'i dbus nas mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan dang / de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / de nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la'ang yi ge so gnyis pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/

de nas phyogs skyong nas rigs drug gi bar du'ang phul nas mthar/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas bdag nyid kyis kyang myangs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhes sogs dang / spro na/ dngos po kun gyi de nyid chos dbyings kun rtog bral/ /zhes sogs kyis kyang bstod do/ /de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje/ /rigs pa'i rgyal mchog khyed la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags kyi/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bgyi/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ 'dus pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba gdab ste/ gnang ba byin par bsams la/ slar mchod cing hūm̐ badz+rodaḥtiṣ+ṭha zhes pas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg ste/ lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis rdo rgyus la sogs pas dkar por byug gnyis ka la mtshan ma rdo rje re re dris te/ ras bzang pos mgrin pa dkris/ yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas pa'i nyungs kar gyis brdeg gu gul gyi dud pas bdug

tsu ta la sogs pas kha brgyan/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga rnams dang / srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang mas dgang / rnam rgyal gyi steng du dri bzang gi chus bkang ba'i dung chos dang / rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag la/ bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis su bskyed pa'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu nas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed nas/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ me tog phreng ba nas bzung ste/ rnam rgyal la sngags gsum char brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla/ las thams cad pa la snying po de ltar bzla'o/ /slar yang phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod nas/ mchod yon phul te lha rnams zhu nas chu'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas grub na sbyin sreg bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul ba la chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed par bya ste/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen glo can rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi/ /yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang / /kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan gyis bsod nams 'dod/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/

/'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol 'bras gnyer na/ /gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub/ /'di yis 'jig rten pha rol min/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ /zhes pa'i don bshad la/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo bskyed du gzhug go /de nas bla ma rigs bdag mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ slob ma rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i gzugs su gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi zhal nas zhugs shing byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ hūm̐ zhes pas pad+ma nas phyir phyung nas rang rang gi gdan la 'khod par bsams la/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor/ /bdag gis ston pa dges chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ bu tshur shog shig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/

/'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod pas spro ba bskyed nas/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / yi ge so gnyis pas bsrungs nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg cing / hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje dang / mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dang / spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo bsgom/ yang yas rim gyis reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyag mtshan de rnams yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par bsam mo/ /de nas mgo bor me tog mdun du spos/ snying khar dri/ mdun du mar me rnams kyis mchod/ a shwad tha la sogs pa'i so shing me tog gi rtse mo can rnams dri bzang gi chus byug cing / yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas pas slob ma la byin/ des kyang kha shar du bltas nas so shing 'chos nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dor bas rtse mo shar/ lho/ nub/ byang / steng / 'og tu bltas na/ zhi/ rgyas/ dbang / drag mkha' spyod/ sa 'og rnams 'grub cing / dkyil 'khor du ma lhung na dngos grub med par go bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ nī tsa a s+ya bi shwa dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa'i chu khyor ba gsum 'thung du bcug hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang / che ba stan du byin gyis brlabs la/ yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas shing sbyin/ srung skud dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum sgril du byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon par bcing zhing / yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas pas bsrung ngo / /de nas 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/

/gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni shin du dkon/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon chad sdig pa ci mchis pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ /de dag thams cad zad gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod tshul gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /spyad mchog 'di la gang rnams kyis/ /blo gros shin du dri med pa/ /de rnams kyis ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed/ /gang gis khyed rnams rgyal ba kun/ /bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyi/ /bstan pa 'di la thams cad ni/ /yongs su bzung zhing skye 'gyur ba/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen las/ /legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pas chos bshad la/ ku sha'i stan la nyal du bcug ste/ rmi lam gang cung zad mthong ba/ snga dro nga la smros shig ces brjod cing rmi lam bzang na spro ba bskyed cing / ngan na bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/

/byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so sor brtan por bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /dkon mchog gsum mchog bla na med/ /sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung / /de nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de nyid kyis ni bar du bzung / /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag pa/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan/ /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin/ /kun nas so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyi zhing / /sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod pa ni/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa ste nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// //gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ nangs par snga bar langs la sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar byas nas/ ras bal gyi srad bu lnga tshon sna lngas kha dog bsgyur la/ dri bzang pos byug rang don grub rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i lag par bzung la/ dkar po k+ṣe las rnam snang rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa zhal dkar po ma he'i gdong pa can/ de bzhin du ser po ma/ dmar po me/ ljang khu da/

sngon po ya rnams las rin 'byung rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs rtsa zhal gyi kha dog 'gyur zhing / gzhan zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par sgrub thabs ltar bsgom/ rang gi mig gnyis dzaḥlas byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi mar bsgoms la 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang / oṃ dhī ta diṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dza zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mdun du spyan drangs la/ oṃ āḥpra ya tsa kā la a ri swā tsa kra su kra na ma hūm̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas ye shes kyi srad bu rnams lag par gnas pa'i dam tshig gi srad bu rnams la thim par bsams la/ rnam snang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma dang lhan cig oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmā/ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥ a d+yan ta a nu pra bi ta sarba dharmāḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas gcig du bsgril zhing dri bzangs kyi chus byugs la gser gyi snod du bzhag me tog la sogs pas mchod/ yi ge so gnyis pa bzlas pas bsrung ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i nub tu slob dpon dang / shar du slob ma 'dug la g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte bar thig skud bzung nas/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod cing slob ma la thig sna gtad/ des kyang dz+dzaḥgasum brjod cing drangs la lte bar bzung la slob dpon gyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing / thig gi sgra dang / sems can don la khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces pas bskul bas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thig la thim par bsgoms la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du g.yas skor gyis slob dpon lho dang / slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa dang / slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang / slob dpon rlung dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas nub kyi rtsa thig dang /

slob dpon de nyid dang / slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi rtsa thig dang / slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang / de nas gzhung du ma bshad kyang / lag len la slob dpon de nyid dang / slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang / slob dpon bden bral dang / slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa ste/ thams cad kyang nam mkha' dang sa gzhi gnyis la btab nas/ las thig gi cha dbye ba'i phyir bskor phyogs dang go rim sngar dang 'dra ba las/ las thig dkyil 'khor rta babs snam bu bzhi ma spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i nang du lha snam cha chen gcig bzhag nas rdo rje'i rwa ba cha phran gcig zlum skor byas te/ de'i nang du tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du cha chen re re dor nas/ cha phran re'i thig bzhi btab pas re'u mig dgur 'gyur ro/ /de nas thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ hrīḥlas mig g.yas g.yon gnyis nyi zla dang / mig 'bras hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer bskyed la/ hi hi zhes brjod cing / khro bo'i lta bas bltas pas/ khro bo'i rdo rje 'phros thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i bgegs rnams bcom par bsams la/ dri bzang gi chus sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig phyis te thig gis bri ba'i cho ga'o// ༈ /de nas rdul tshon kha dog lnga la yak+ṣe ma me da bris te phyogs ma 'dzol bar bkod la/ bsang sbyangs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rigs lngar bskyed/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i thugs kha nas ye shes kyi rdul tshon sngar ltar 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang / sngags kyis bkug la mchod cing bstod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdul tshon du bltas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes dang / yi ge so gnyis pa lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas oṃ badz+ra bai ga akra ma ho zhes brjod la rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/

'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis re khā lnga'i sgo tshad gcig gi bar bris la/ snod la sogs pa bzhag cing / rdo rje bzhag pas bsrung ngo / /phyis sbrel ran pa dang snod bsal la rtsig pa gzhan dang sbrel lo/ /de nas rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang rung ste/ le dgu'i ka thig rnams gzhi ser po la/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa bri/ rdo rje rwa ba gzhi ser po la rdo rje sngon po bri/ le dgu'i gzhi sngon po la dbus su ro mgo med/ lag med kyi steng du gtso bo'i mtshan ma bri/ shar gyi re mig tu mgo bo la sogs pa dang / lha snam phyogs mdog can la sngar gyi phyag mtshan rnams rim pa bzhin du bri/ sgo mtshams brgyad du/ ro langs brgyad dngos sam/ phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon nam/ thig le bri/ sgo dang rta babs/ dur khrod/ rdo rwa/ me ri rnams spyi dang mthun par bri'o/ /de ltar legs par bris zin pa dang tshon lhag ma rnams mchod nas/ ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs khar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la/ tshon gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag ste/ tshon gyis bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dri bzang gi chus byug cing / mchod rdzas rnams bzang bar bsham/ rnam rgyal bum pa shar sgo'i thad dang / las bum dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dgod/ gdugs dang / ba dan dang / gos zung la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sogs 'og du dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams te rgyan dgram pa'o// //de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs su 'dug ste/ rdul tshon sbyang ba'i phyir/

me long gi ngos la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥbazlas shing / dang por gtor ma/ de nas ting lo dang chang bus sbyang / gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar brdeg dkyil 'khor gyi ma dag pa dang 'bags btsog rnams til la thim par bsam la til bsreg las thams cad pa'i chu dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni ces sogs kyis bkru ste sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sngags gnyis kyis stong par bsgoms nas/ lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar dam tshig pa bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ yi ge so gnyis pa brjod pas bgegs bskrad cing / sta gon gyi lha la mchod de dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ zhal gyi grangs dang mthun par lha dgu la dmigs te/ yi ge bdun pa brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas/ de bzhin du zhal dang mthun par ā li kā li phrag re dang / yi ge brgya pa re re bzlas/ de nas sta gon gyi skabs ltar sngags mchod/ phyi mchod/ gos zung / 'dod yon lngas mchod nas/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan pa/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod/ /zhes pas mchod la/ nang bdud rtsi dang / bstod pa yang sngar bzhin byas te/ sgrub pa'i grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug nas/ rang phyi rol du phyin nas smyon pa 'jigs byed/ dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams la gtor ma byin la/ nang du 'ongs te/ rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas nas lhag chad zhi ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa bzlas te/

dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas par mos la/ dbang bskur gyi skabs ltar dbang thams cad rdzogs par blangs la/ slob dpon gyi las thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par bsams te bdag 'jug go /de nas khrus byas pa'i slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyi rol du sta gon ltar 'khod nas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la sngar ltar/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ rnam snang rdo rje 'jigs byed du bskyed/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba gtad/ gdong g.yogs dmar po bcing / las thams cad pa'i chu dang / yi ge so gnyis pas bsangs nas/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ slob dpon du gsol ba gdab pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba rnams sngar ltar byas la/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin zhes dri/ des/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ /zhes lan gdab/ slob ma'i snying khar/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi mtshon byed rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsgoms la/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu sems bskyed pa'i bsam pas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā ta da yā mi zhes brjod/ snying khar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brtan par bya'o/ /de nas ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du bcug la mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/

khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes pas phan yon gyi sgo nas dang / 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems/ /zhes pas nyes dmigs dang / snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes pas phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i dang / dung chos su dri bzang po'i chu la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha bdun bzlas pas slob ma'i khar blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥzhes pas mna'i chu blud pa dang / deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ zhes bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ slob ma 'od dpag med rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su haḥ snying khar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ lte bar me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba'i dbus su āḥ rkang 'og du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de la dzhaiṃḥdrag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i gzugs can rlung gis bskyod pas rkang mthil gnyis nas zhugs te/

lte ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam par phyin nas/ de dang des bskyod nas shin du drag du 'bar bas snying kha'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ dpral ba'i chu khol de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs pas rgyud tshim par gyur pa'i slob ma rlung gis 'degs bzhin par bsams la/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs dpag du med pa spyan drangs nas slob ma la thim zhing / gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag du sgrogs bzhin pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā be sha ya/ satwaṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dbab bo/ /phebs pa dang / 'od dpag med rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i lce la āḥdamar po bkod la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la/ mgon po rdo rje chos chen po/ /snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che/ /smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /dge dang mi dge legs par 'dri/ /zhes brjod la 'dri bar bya'o/ /de yang gsung babs pas dge ba dang mi dge ba smra ba'o/ /thugs babs pas ni 'jig rten gsum du rtog pa shes so/ /sku babs pas nam mkha' la 'phar ro/ /de'i tshe mgo bo'i steng du lam̐ las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa des mnan par bsgoms na mi 'gul bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngar gyi me tog gi phreng ba de trāṃ las rin po che'i me tog du mos la/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas rang gi lha la phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na stoṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog mgo la bcing / mig du oṃ bsams la/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyed kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzod/ /ces pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ he badz+ra pā sh+ye zhes brjod pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o//

//de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpar dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag la mgon pos dbang bkur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ las bum gyi chu dang / yi ge so gnyis pas slob ma dang bum pa bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ ya dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs de rnams la mchod cing / rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i yum rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /zhes rnam rgyal bum pa nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis chu blangs la/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi zhes brjod cing / dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes mchod/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/

/de rnams ni lha dang dbang rdzas kyi khyad par ma gtogs 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du slob ma dang / dbu rgyan bsang sbyangs/ ma dang rin po che las/ rin chen 'byung ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa zhal ser po ma he'i gdong pa can/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra bar bskyed nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur par bltas pa'i bar du byas la/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyis dbu rgyan bcing / chus kyang dbang bskur nas rin 'byung gis rgyas gdab/ mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor phung gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma dang / rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ me dang pad+ma las/ 'od dpag med rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa zhal dmar po ma he'i gdong pa can du bskyed pa sogs byas te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir gzung / /zhes brjod de rdo rje snying ga la sogs par reg la/ lag pa g.yas su byin/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas gdab la mchod nas/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma dang / dril bu bsang sbyangs/ da dang ral gri las don grub rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa zhal ljang khu ma he'i gdong pa can du bskyed pa sogs byas te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes pas dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin/

chus kyang dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas rgyas gdab mchod nas/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ don grub kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma bsang sbyangs/ k+ṣe dang 'khor lo las/ rnam snang rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa zhal dkar po ma he'i gdong pa can du bskyed pa sogs byas la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra nā ma a bhī ṣe ka te/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje la sogs pa sngar me tog gang la phog kyang mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi ming gdags so/ /chus kyang dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab la mchod nas/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /dbang bskur ba 'di dag gis bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang / sngags bsgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang lnga po de nyid cod paṇa gyi dbang ste/ thams cad du tsartsi ka la sogs pa rnams kyi cod paṇa la dbang gi tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du/ shing stan la slob ma gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis bzhag go /gong ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus pa bskur te/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas par byin la/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/

/bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zung / /zhes dang / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes brjod pa rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go /aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje dril bur rab grub phyir/ /bu yis yang dag gus par gyis/ /khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod de dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsgoms nas/ shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'i tshul byas la/ yid kyi lus brtan de nyid kyis/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab du bshad/ /gang gis lus 'di thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab du grags/ /zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste/ sher rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /ces pa'i don ngo sprad la/ chu dbang bskur nas/ dkyil 'khor dang / lha'i de kho na nyid bshad do/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min dbang po/ /mi mnyam med pas gru bzhi pa/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /dad pa rnam dag shar sgo'o/ /yang dag spong bzhi brtson 'grus ni/ /rnam par dag pa lho sgo'o/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam bzhi yi/ /dran pa rnam dag nub kyi sgo/ /dbang po lnga yi ting nge 'dzin/ /rnam par dag pa byang sgo'o/ /rtog dpyod dga' bde btang snyoms te/ /bsam gtan bzhi dag rta babs bzhi/ /dpa' bar 'gro sogs ting 'dzin bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa 'dod snam bzhi/ /don tshig nges spobs gzungs bzhi po/

/dag pa 'dod yon lha mo'o/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'o/ /gsung rab yan lag dgu bstan pa/ /dag pa dril bu ba dan no/ /byang chub yan lag bdun dag pa/ /drwa ba drwa phyed la sogs bdun/ /rnam thar brgyad dag ka ba'am/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i logs zur ro/ /sngags thog chos 'khor bskor ba dag /rdo rje'i phreng thig nyams ldan pa'o/ /'jig tshogs lta ri nyi shu dag /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams so/ /kha dog lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /steng 'og rtsig pa'i rim pa'o/ /gcig dang du bral chos ston dag /lha gnas sna tshogs pad gdan no/ /byang chub sems min myu gu bskyed/ /dag phyir nyi zla'i gdan dang ldan/ /snying rje'i bdud rtsis yongs gang ba/ /dag pa bum pa brgyad yin no/ /chos kyi sgron ma dri dang zas/ /dag pa snang grag lha bshos so/ /zhes brjod/ de nas lha'i de kho na nyid brjod par bya ste/ dam pa'i don du bya ba dag /dus ni dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs/ /zhal brgyad thun tshod brgyad yin no/ /zhal dgu thun tshod spyi yin no/ /phyag dang rwa gnyis zla ba dang / /zla ba phyed dang yang dag sbyor/ /zhon pa bcu drug dus dang ni/ /zla ba yi ni zhag tu shes/ /zhal ni gza' dgu dag tu shes/ /phyag ni rgyu skar dag dang sbyar/ /zhabs ni 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang / /dus bzhi yang ni de bzhin no/ /mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang / /snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis/ /glang chen lpags pa bgegs chen ste/ /drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal che/ /ser bar byed pa'i gtso bo'o/ /kha dog nag po byams pa che/ /thod pa'i rgyan ni mi 'gyur ba'o/ /'jam dpal min pa'i zhal brgyad po/ /dag pa ro langs brgyad yin no/ /zhes brjod cing / de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ slob dpon la yang tshang ba ni slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do/ /de nas slob ma rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur bsgom du bcug la/

sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten kun du thams cad na/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes pa rnams rim pa bzhin du byin te rjes gnang ngo / /rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ zhu ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag du zung / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod de rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de nas slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis snying khar chos gos kyi grwa nas 'dzin pa'i tshul dang / g.yas pas mchog sbyin du byas pas/ oṃ ngas khyod 'dir ni lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog tu grub bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /kyai che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya bhu ra bhu waḥswa/ zhes bya bas lung bstan nas/ gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad do/ /de nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so zhes brjod par bya ste lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyan rang gi sa yid byed kyi sems bcom par bsam ste gsang bar brjod pa'o/

/de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /srid pa shin du grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yi/ /de yang nges par brten mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya ste/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /da ni khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis ni mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rtag tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes pa'i don bshad de/ dbugs dbyung sbyin pa'o/ /rjes gnang la sogs pa lnga po 'di dag ni slob ma'i dbang tsam don du gnyer ba la cod paṇa gyi dbang lnga'i rjes sam/ skabs 'dir ram/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la yang sbyar bar yang bshad do/ /de ltar na phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ slob dpon gyi dbang ngam bum pa'i dbang ngo // //de nas slob mas rig ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas sogs sam/

e ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma chos kyang tshogs kyi gtso/ /bdag la dam tshig de nyid stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /zhes pas gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcing / bla mas rang rigs bdag mi bskyod pa dang / rig ma mā ma kīr bskyed snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor ba byas pas dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas yab yum dpag du med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor brtan par byas pa de nyid srin lag dang mthe bong gis brtsir te/ btung ba rin chen 'di de ni/ /lus kyi rdo rje rab gsal byed/ /bu khyod rtag tu shes nas kyi/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung mdzod/ /ces dang / hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥs slob ma'i lce thog du sbyin/ des kyang a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing blangs nas myang la mgrin par mid do/ /shes rab kyis kyang rang gi pad+ma na gnas pa'i thig le slob ma'i khar byin la sngar bzhin myangs pas mchog du dga' ba'i bde bas rgyud gang zhing yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsgoms la/ gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ khyod kyis kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang ba'i dbang ngo // //de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ /mgon la dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcings te/ rig ma'i lag pa slob ma'i lag par gtad par bsams la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags/

/rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di'ang dag pa yin/ /de bas 'khor bar brjod bral nyid/ /khyed kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod la byin pa dang / des tsan+dan la sogs pas byugs/ me tog la sogs pas brgyan/ gos med par byas te/ pad+ma rgyas par ston cing / dri chen dri chu za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med gus mchod de bzhin du/ /bha ga pad+mar tsum+bha na/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bus smros shig /ces so/ /des kyang / dri chen dri chu sogs za ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la'ang tsum+bha na'ang / /zhes lan btag pas mnyes te/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag du bzhugs/ /bhañdza mok+ṣa ho/ zhes brjod par bsam/ de nas slob ma rigs bdag mi bskyod pa dang / rig ma mā ma kīr bskyed la/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal te/ rdo rje pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pas skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ rim gyis bsrubs pas byang chub sems kyis gsang gnas kyi bar gang ba khyad par gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ nor bu'i rtse mo'i mthar thug pa'i bar gang nas phyir ma 'dzag pa chags pa dang / chags bral gyi mtha' spangs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes te/

de la ci nus su gnas par bya ba ste/ rnal 'byor pa yis ji srid du/ /byang sems 'byin par mi byed pa/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ phung po rnam shes brgyal ba la/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' khams rdo rje kun sbyor dang / /reg bya yis ni rmad byung che'i/ /bde ba bskyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa po/ /dga' bral dag gi dus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos pa brtan par gyis/ /pad+ma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yis/ /lte ba mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son bltas pas/ /ye shes bskyed pa gang yin pa/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes pas brgyan/ /chags pa ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa bskal pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon 'byor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod la ye shes ngos bzung du bcug la/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi brtan nas/ lus thams cad bde bas khyab pa la sems bzung / des nas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo // //de nas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcings sam ma bcings kyang rung ste/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams su myong ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad na/

rgyud las/ de ltar bzhi pa de bzhin yang zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su yum dang lhan sbyor gyi lha'i skur bsgom pa de nyid goms pa'i stobs kyis gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal lha'i skur gnas gyur te/ rang dang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gsal la ma 'gags pa mngon du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku dang / dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su phyag rgya la brten pa'i bde ba de nyid rgyun goms pas sngar gyi bde ba las ches khyad par du 'phags pa 'dzag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po yang dag rig pa 'khor 'das thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam par mngon du gyur pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus su bde ba'i ngo bo stong par bsgoms pa'i don goms pa las/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ thob bya 'bras bu dang / thob byed lam dang / lam de goms pa'i sems la sogs pa'i rtog pa dang bral zhing khams bco brgyad dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes la sogs pa don dam par ma grub pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba mngon du gyur pa ni chos kyi sku dang / de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu 'dres nas lha sku bde ba dang bcas pa'i snang ba mi 'dor zhing de dag gi ngo bo yang stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba chos thams cad yin lugs la zhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ 'bras bu dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni lus mnyam bzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan zhing / ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyi lus yum dang bcas pa'i lha'i skur gsal ba dang / de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba dang / de dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'jig 'gro 'ong / rtag chad 'khor 'das bde sdug la sogs pa gnyis snang thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/

de gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang la ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po min cing bsgom pa min/ /khams kyang min cing rnam shes min/ /nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa'i/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes pa'i don ngo sprad/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed de dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas spro ba bskyed de dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol bar/ /de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ /mi tshugs pa dang ma bcings par/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin du zhi ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin du grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par spang mi bya/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la mi smad do/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung por smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / /gdug la byams pa rtag tu spong / /chos la tshad bzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/

/rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya'o/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med par gyur na/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ /bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje spyan bcas pas/ /kun gyis tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ /rgyal srid bdag por brtan pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs so/ /de ring khyod ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro la bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la don bshad de/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung mtshams phyed par bya'o/ /de nas slob mas gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgo ba'i/ /gsung ni de ltar bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar khas blang ngo / /'byor na sbyin sreg kyang bya zhing / yon phul tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga bzhin byas la slar yang / dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ste bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas rdul tshol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ de nas lha yis nga rgyal brtan pas chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o zhes brjod cing /

rdo rje'i rtse mos dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por bshig cing lha'i mtshan ma rnams shar nas rim gyis bsdus la/ don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad sbyin/ tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor nas sngar bshad pa'i sngags dang / skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu phyung la/ phur khung 'o mas kyang bkang / thig rjes dbyi ba sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// //da ni de dag gi nges pa bshad par bya ste/ rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud 'di la/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i man ngag bla ma mal lots+tsha ba nas dpal sa skya pa chen po la brgyud pa'i lugs bzang po 'di ni bla ma de nyid kyi rtog bdun gyi ṭī kar bkod pa 'di yin pas sgrub thabs ṭī ka las rdzogs par thon la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thun mong ma yin pa rnams ṭī kar 'byung zhing / thun mong ba rnams nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar kha 'phangs par mdzad do/ /de la nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dgra nag gi dkyil chog 'di yin la/ 'di dang des mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi dkyil chog gnyis dkyil 'khor so so'i khyad chos dang / 'gyur cung zad tsam ma gtogs pa cho ga'i 'gros khyad par mi snang la/ bla ma'i phyag len yang rjes mdzad pa'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil mchog 'di nyid kyi steng nas 'dor len mdzad pas 'dir yang de bzhin du bris so/ /de la sngon du bsnyen pa ni ṭī kar/ de yang ma he'i gdong can gyi rnal 'byor gyis zhes pa'i bar gyis bsnyen pa bstan te/ 'og gi sgrub pa'i thabs ltar lha bskyed nas/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'abum du bskyal/ thun mtshams su yi ge so gnyis pa dang / yi ge bdun pa yang stong stong tsam bzla'o zhes gsungs la/ sa'i cho ga dang / lha sta gon la ṭī kar de nas dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug pa'i dus su/ sa'i cho ga dang /

sta gon gyi skabs su/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dbus dang dgur/ zhal gyi grangs dang mthun par ya ma rā dza brjod cing / thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod/ mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab pa sogs 'dra zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / gzhan rnams dkyil chog bzhin du bya dgos pa las/ sa chog gi skabs su bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg nas/ lha sta gon gyi skabs su phab nas gsal gdab pa ni 'di la mi rung ste/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs su phyag mtshan dang ro langs brgyad bsgom pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na bsdu ba'i lugs med do snyam na/ nā ro pa'i man ngag las 'byung ste/ bde mchog bzhin no/ /sa'i lha mo sta gon ṭī kar ma gsungs kyang thun mong ba yin pa la dgongs la/ lha sta gon gyi skabs su rten thog mar bskyed nas/ brten pa lha snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa ni 'di'i lugs ma yin te/ bdag bskyed dang 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs gnyis char du rten brten pa cig char du bskyed pa de bzhin du bya dgos pa'i phyir te/ nā ro pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog lo hi pa'i phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'i skabs bzhin no/ /mchod pa la grangs ka gsal bar ma gsungs kyang bdag bskyed kyi skabs kyi mchod pa'i grangs rnams dang / gos zung gi mchod pa ni nges par dgos la/ nyer spyod kyi tshigs bcad gsal kha med pa rnams la dri med yid 'ong sbyar ba ni bla ma gong ma'i phyag len du snang ste/ kye rdor man ngag lugs bzhin no/ /'dir ni nag po dkyil chog gi rab gnas kyi skabs bzhin sbyar na yang rung ngo / /bum pa dbul ba ni 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'byung ba yin gyis 'dir ni mi dgos so/ /snyan gsan dbab pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa ni dkyil chog gnyis las 'byung bas/ de ltar byed na dkyil 'khor ma bteg pa'i sngon du gtor ma rnams bsngos nas/

de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor 'degs dgos so/ /yang na phyag len spyi dang mthun par bum pa sta gon gyi rjes su gtor ma bsngos nas slob ma sta gon gyi rjes su dkyil 'khor 'degs par bya'o/ /bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su ṭī kar bum pa lhag gnas la bum pa gnyis bcas te/ gnyis ka la mtshan ma rdo rje re re bris te sman la sogs pa 'dra/ bum pa gnyis kar lha bskyed pa nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las zhi ba'i 'jam dpal/ de las khro bor bskyed de/ de dag la dmigs la/ rnam rgyal la sngags gsum char brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas/ las thams cad pa la snying po de ltar bzlas zhes gsungs so/ /yan lag bzhi rdzogs gsal bar mi snang yang / bdag mdun gzhan gyi rigs pas nges par dgos so/ /slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su ṭī kar slob ma lhag gnas gzhan dang 'dra'o zhes gsungs la/ 'dir mkhas pa dag 'jigs byed la yum med pas/ nang dbang bskur ba med ces gsungs kyang bla ma rigs bdag yab yum du bsgoms nas nang dbang bskur ba rung zhes bla ma gsung ngo / /slob ma la mchod pa'i nyer spyod la/ dkyil chog 'di gnyis kyi lugs ltar zhal zas med pa dang / kyai rdor lugs gnyis dang / gsang 'dus ltar zhal zas yod pa/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog ltar de'i steng du rol mo yang dbul ba dang gsum yod do/ /thig chog gi skabs su ṭī kar thig chog dang tshon chog bya lugs mi 'dra ba ni dkyil 'khor ji lta bu bri zhing / mtshan ma dgod pa mi 'dra'o/ /zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs la/ ye thig gi rjes su las thig btab pa ni dkyil chog las 'byung ba de bzhin byed pa'am/ phyag len la sa chog gi rjes su las thig btab nas sta gon la 'jug par mdzad pas de bzhin yang rung ngo / /thig chog gi sngon du sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar bya bar gsungs pa ni thig tshon gyi cho ga dngos gzhir gtogs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/

phyag len la slob ma sta gon gyi rjes su thig tshon byin brlabs byas nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba la 'jug pa'i tshe mi dgos so/ /de ltar na rgyan dgram pa'i rjes su sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor sbyang ba la 'jug ste/ ṭī kar 'byung ngo / /'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs su 'byung yang ye thig gi bskor phyogs ni 'jig rten pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi dbang du bya dgos te bde mchog bzhin no/ /thig tshon gyi rigs lnga ni rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i skabs su ṭī kar mchod pa'i yo byad dang tshogs la sogs pa bshams te/ de nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa ni bdag nyid lhar bskyed de/ bya ba rdzogs par byas la/ rdul tshon sbyang ba ni lho phyogs kyi sgo nas me long gi ngos la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la/ dang por gtor ma/ de nas ting lo dang chang bus sbyang ngo / /gu gul gyis bdug nyungs kar brdeg 'di dag ni hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥbazlas shing til bsreg de nas las thams cad pa'i chus bkrus te sbyang ba'o/ /de nas tha mal pa'i tshon mi dmigs par byas la/ rtog pa bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ltar/ stong pa nas dam tshig sems dpa'i bar du bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug rigs bdag gis mtshon pa'i bar du byas la/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa ni zhal re re zhing yi ge bdun pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de bzhin du zhal re re zhing ā li kā li phrag re bzla/ de bzhin du zhal re re zhing yi ge brgya pa re re bzlas/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod ces gsungs so/ /de la lho phyogs kyi sgo nas zhes pa ni 'jig rten pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /rten brten pa gcig char du bskyed pa ni dngos su 'byung zhing / ye shes pa gzhug pa ni sta gon gyi lha gzhug pa yin gyis/
